items.title: Clarify candidate ledgers and scheduler boundary in the ProofStory plan
items.context: Fix four/five rule mismatch; make candidate milestone ledger gate-consumed only after accepted intent interpretation; state slicing is required for oversized ledgers but automatic parallel execution is optional and belongs to Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot work.
items.userSees: The user sees this exact document wording: "This progressive model has five rules:" and "The milestone ledger may be created as a candidate ledger before intent collision, but it becomes gate-consumed only after the accepted intent interpretation confirms it." The same document also says automatic parallel child-story execution is optional and belongs to a later Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot story.

happy.desc: The document says the progressive model has five rules and lists five rules.
The lifecycle text treats milestone ledgers before intent collision as candidate ledgers and only gate-consumes them after accepted intent interpretation.

edge.desc: The document does not imply child stories must run in parallel when many milestones exist.

adversarial.desc: The document keeps Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot automatic parallel execution out of the MVP implementation scope.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "This progressive model has five rules" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md && ! rg -n "This progressive model has four rules" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document now says the progressive model has five rules and the old four-rules sentence is absent.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "candidate milestone ledger|confirmed milestone ledger|gate-consumed only after the accepted intent" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The lifecycle and ledger sections now distinguish candidate ledgers from confirmed gate-consumed ledgers.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "no mandatory parallel child-story execution|parallel execution is optional" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document explicitly avoids making many milestone slices force parallel child-story execution.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Automatic parallel child-story dispatch belongs to a dedicated Scheduler,|Unattended, or Autopilot development story" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The MVP boundary keeps scheduler/unattended/autopilot automatic parallel execution out of the ProofStory M0-M2 scope.
Whitespace is clean and the edited open-source document remains English-only.
